```
import { BrowserAnimationsModule } from '@angular/platform-browser/animations';
```

@DzmitryShylovich  Also, I assume the `@angular/animations` npm package is still required? But the module defs are in platform-browser?

Cause error when calling `ngc`
```
Calling function 'style', function calls are not supported. Consider replacing the function or lambda with a reference to an exported function
```
import `style` from `@angular/animations` 

in 2.4.8 all works fine

body:
Might be worth mentioning the mapping needed in systemjs.config.js (for those that use systemjs) as well as otherwise it won't load.

```
map = {
'@angular/platform-browser/animations': 'npm:@angular/platform-browser/bundles/platform-browser-animations.umd.js',
...
}
```
Sorry all! The changelog was incorrect. I merged  #14729 from @DzmitryShylovich to fix this.

issue.title: style() from animations is incompatible with AOT & metadata collector

issue.body:
In 4.0.0-rc.1, the `style()` DSL function from animations is not statically analyzable, hence it fails AOT compilation.

> Error encountered resolving symbol values statically. Calling function 'style', function calls are not supported. Consider replacing the function or lambda with a reference to an exported function

https://github.com/angular/angular/blob/830393d234d2b7a41a5f1db375613ffa8dde97c3/modules/%40angular/animations/src/animation_metadata.ts#L341
